business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Asset-light, scalable, cloud-based vertical SaaS model with in-house product engineering and R&D; no manufacturing or physical raw-material supply chain. Products are built on proprietary platforms (SARAS core) with open, industry standards-compliant APIs. Delivery is through subsidiaries in the UK, USA, Singapore and India, plus a presence in Dubai. Workloads run on third-party cloud infrastructure (Microsoft Azure and AWS) and on the Company's own GPU infrastructure for the highest-volume/most-sensitive use cases, using a mix of proprietary, open-source and commercially hosted LLMs (OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, Claude Sonnet, Mistral).
